description: This file contains unit tests for the ClientDirectory class within the Orleans project, specifically testing client lookup functionalities, remote contact retrieval, and update propagation in a silo cluster environment.

classes.name: ClientDirectoryTests
classes.description: Unit test class for testing ClientDirectory behaviors in Orleans, including local and remote lookups, route updates, and failure handling.

methods.name: TryLocalLookupTests
methods.description: Tests the ability of ClientDirectory to correctly perform local client lookups, including adding, removing, and verifying clients.

methods.name: LocalLookupTests
methods.description: Asynchronous tests verifying client lookup behavior, ensuring correct handling of unknown, local, and remote clients.

methods.name: RemoteLookupSuccessTests
methods.description: Tests successful retrieval of client routes from remote silos and handling of remote silo shutdown.

methods.name: RemoteLookupFailureTests
methods.description: Verifies behavior when remote silo contact attempts fail, including retries and error handling.

methods.name: PublishChangesSuccessTests
methods.description: Tests the propagation of client route updates across the silo cluster, including handling silo failures and routing updates.
